title: Decent work & economic growth
summary: From Potential to Paycheck - Building Careers and Businesses That Last.

bodyMarkdown:
## Dignity is not just a value. It is a right.

India's rural youth are not unemployed because they don't want to work - they are unemployed because the system never gave them a fair pathway to dignified employment. And those who run local traditional businesses often lack digital tools, business knowledge, and market access to grow beyond survival.

Megh Foundation's Decent Work & Economic Growth program addresses both realities: employment support and local business growth support.

## Part 1 - Employment support

### Finding the right job. Not just any job.

- Career counseling and authentic guidance
- Job readiness workshops on workplace culture, communication, and professionalism
- Workplace rights and labor law awareness
- Resume writing and interview preparation
- Active employer connections and placement support
- Post-placement follow-up and handholding
- Ongoing support until youth are stable in their career

## Part 2 - Local youth-led business support

### Rooted in tradition. Ready for the future.

We support young people running local, traditional, and community-rooted businesses with digital training and business development support.

- Digital training: social media, online presence, digital payments, basic accounting
- Business planning and financial literacy support
- Marketing and branding guidance for traditional products
- Access to digital tools: Google Business, WhatsApp Business, e-commerce basics
- Connecting local businesses to wider markets and customers
- Mentorship from business professionals and industry experts
- Support in formalizing and registering businesses

## Who this is for

Young entrepreneurs aged 18-35 who are running or planning to start local, traditional, or community-rooted businesses in rural and semi-urban Gujarat.

## One line

We support youth who want a job. We support youth who want to build one. We support every youth.
